svg.title: Flagellin export through the central channel
svg.desc: Gram-negative envelope section with the flagellar motor and a short filament: an unfolded flagellin chain passes from the cytoplasmic export gate through the central channel of rod, hook and filament towards the capped tip; a folded flagellin with its chaperone waits in the cytoplasm.
